visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Zillow Showcase. Photos plus 3D / floor plan / map tabs, one monthly payment with P&I tax HOA, nearby schools, tax history, lot size. We add place climb, assessor lot lines, published CC&Rs, a live broker, and one payment formula (computeMonthlyPiti).

competitiveBrief.source: design_system/public/references/listing-detail.md + taste-catalog listing-detail modules. Beats must be visible in the judged shots.
competitiveBrief.productLock: Full-bleed hero + catalog Carousel/Tabs on the photograph. Fold ask is one shadcn ButtonGroup (Tour/Call/Text). Save is the right Sheet. Share is the centered Dialog. Navy/cream/Geist/Amboqia.
competitiveBrief.refuse: Frost overlay, cream-box Save/Share, leftover Tour/Call/Text chips, house drawer, localhost share URL, inventing demoMatch or competitiveBriefPass.

beats.text: The listing photograph is full-bleed (listing-hero-bleed) in the first viewport, not a column frame.
shadcn Carousel prev/next sits on that photograph and the house still fills the first viewport.
beUI pill tabs (Photos / Floor / Map) sit on the photograph on a cream track, not a navy filmstrip.
Street is the H1 and the list price sits under it on the fold, before the long listed-by line.
A price cut reads as two prices (from, drop, date) on the fold, not one muted fifty-thousand line.
Tour, Call, and Text are one connected shadcn ButtonGroup on the fold — shared edges, not leftover outline chips.
Save opens the catalog right Sheet: title, description, email Label and Input, footer, default close, dim overlay with no frost.
Share opens a centered shadcn Dialog with the ryan-realty.com listing URL and Copy link, dim overlay with no frost.

note: PAGE_INVENTORY listing (house URL) 12 sections. Tour / Call / Text is the ask WHILE THE HOME IS ON THE MARKET, Pending included (a pending home takes backup offers and is a live lead source). SITE-21: when isPublicOffMarketStatus(status) is true — Closed, Expired, Canceled, Withdrawn — the page publishes the sold facts, the active homes in this city and a saved search instead: no payment, no market-ask instrument, no three-act close, and no tel: or sms: anywhere inside <main> (the brokerage line stays in V3Footer, outside it). Face Est. $/mo is off the page so Payment is the one number. Cookies cannot cover the ask. No leftover HUD, CMA, rental, or doors on this route.

dataChanges.unchanged: Every listing figure traces to getListingDetail, photos, videos, history, open houses, brokers, reviews, related homes, plat documents, taxlots. JSON-LD RealEstateListing + BreadcrumbList still emit from MetadataBlock. Payment is computeMonthlyPiti only.
dataChanges.similarHomes: A capped strip of V3ListingRow from the same relatedHomes ranking, same parent. One view-more href.
dataChanges.exploreSections: Parks and trails nearby via LifestyleNearSection thumbs. Golf, events, and city guides are omitted on this house page.

openDefects._: Closed 2026-08-27. Insurance is now an editable input seeded at $1,000 per $300K per year with the assumption stated in the UI; the comparison sentence says 'median list price'; the grain item resolved below.
items: RESOLVED AS CLAIM-WRONG 2026-08-27: NeighborhoodMarketContext publishes the FINEST grain whose rows publish (neighborhood first, city fallback via leftoverListingGrains) and the heading names that grain. Subdivision-grain stats cannot ship honestly: subdivision monthly series are too sparse to chart and neighborhood sold attribution is a known text-join undercount. The page is truthful about its grain; the contract's flat subdivision-grain promise was the wrong side.

OPEN, NEEDS MATT (SITE-33, 2026-09-09). On an OUT-OF-AREA listing the page now says "We don't work in Medford" and offers a broker introduction, while the sidebar card and the mobile bar still offer Tour / Call / Text, and the Payment section still computes a full monthly breakdown for that home. The separate evaluator called the first of these critical: two contradictory asks in one viewport. It was NOT changed in this pass. Matt's 2026-09-08 ruling was explicit and covered four things — the honesty block, noindex with follow preserved, the page still serving, and /oregon/[city] staying indexed — and did not rule on the ask. SITE-21 is the precedent for the fix (it already strips tel:, sms: and the payment from a home the brokerage cannot transact), but out-of-area is not off-market: Ryan Realty holds an Oregon licence and these are live leads, so suppressing the tour CTA on ~4,190 listings is a revenue decision, not a taste one. THE ASK FOR MATT: on an out-of-area listing, does the page keep Tour / Call / Text and the payment, or does it drop to the referral ask alone?

tasteReview.beats: Zillow Showcase listings — we win on named-broker reachability (Tour/Call/Text plus license on the fold) and a dated two-price cut; we lose the gallery as a visual event (ours is a padded Dialog card, theirs is a filmstrip you stay in).
tells: Scrolling lists as the design. — Facts / Overview in save-open-desktop and share-open shots: Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Living area, Property type, Year built, Style, New construction, then Interior rows, past six hairline key-value pairs with no mark, bar, map, or image.
tasteReview.dullest: The Facts/Overview ledger under the overlay: a two-column MLS dump (3, 2, 1,602 sqft, Yes) that is the page's actual body. The first viewport is a garage-forward photo plus leftover Open/Street view chips and a 1/15 postage stamp — portal furniture, not a gallery you stay in.
tasteReview.verdict: This is a catalog-correct listing fold, not a cream box: full-bleed hero, cream Photos/Floor/Map pills on the photograph, connected Tour/Call/Text, Save as the right Sheet, Share as a centered Dialog with a ryan-realty.com URL, so demoMatch is true and competitiveBriefPass is true. It is still a portal page — leftover Open/Street view chips, a postage-stamp filmstrip, and a Facts hairline list — so it is competent, on-brand, and dull, not breathtaking. SEO cannot be verified from these pixels (no document title or JSON-LD in frame); listing inventory is present rather than dropped (two-price cut, DOM, $/sqft, specs, listed-by, broker). That is a hold on SEO from this evidence, not a rise.

defects.finding: Open and Street view sit as leftover outline chips beside a 1/15 postage-stamp thumb, duplicating the Photos/Floor/Map pills already on the photograph.
The cut is two prices plus Cut $15,000 / -2.1% / Sep 9, 2026 as a typed row, not a visual event a buyer would screenshot the way Zillow Showcase encodes a drop.
Overview is a two-column Yes/3/2 hairline dump past six rows; that is a table wearing rules, not a designed facts object.
The filmstrip under the bleed photo is one tiny Spark-looking thumb plus a counter, not a carousel rail with prev/next identity in that strip.
Opened Photos is a padded white Dialog card with the house inset; the photograph is no longer the object the way a lightbox filmstrip is.
The H1 wraps so Place sits alone, and the listed-by line is clipped under the sticky Tour/Call/Text bar.
